scope: Standalone public /listener/:slug only. Legacy/admin Reader word-position selection is excluded. Duration, chapter/segment navigation and accounting still apply.
source_findings: Route passes no readAlongSupported or onReadAlong capability.
Listener uses native media time, exact package segment durations and chapter offsets; no cue fetching or text highlighting.
Shared manifest requires sidecar identities structurally; no schema/storage requirement is waived.
Public legacy listening redirects to standalone Listener; administrative legacy Reader is not an eligible consumer.
